Subject: PremierCare kickoff readiness & owner assignment

Hi team,

Quick wrap from my call with PremierCare this morning — we’re green to move to kickoff but there are a few open items I want written into the pass so CS can prioritize.  TL;DR: annual contract ~USD 480k ARR, go-live target: Sept 1 (pilot to prod), primary use case: patient intake triage and appointment automation via Redwood inference API (low-latency routing, PHI-handling required).

Key context / outstanding items:
- Security & compliance: PremierCare signed basic questionnaire; they want a follow-up for KMS/HSM assumptions and encryption-at-rest confirmation (Rajiv is the IT contact).
- Identity: customer will require SAML SSO (Okta) + attribute mapping — they asked for a sample metadata file and SSO test window.
- Data flow: logs retention requirement = 90 days (they asked about audit log export cadence).
- Integration: HL7->FHIR adapter is upstream; they’ll push patient triage payloads to our ingest endpoint. Rate: expected bursts to 300 req/min, average 80 req/min.
- Success metrics: 95th percentile latency < 250ms for 75% of inference calls; initial cost targets reviewed with Finance (see SOW).

Attachments: SOW v1 and a kickoff checklist (attached). I also linked the HubSpot deal and shared Drive folder below.

Ask for CS: please assign a primary CS lead and a technical owner (for SSO/infra). I recommend Monica Patel as primary given her recent rollout experience with similar PHI customers, and Tessa for implementation PM. Proposed kickoff window: week of Jul 8 — 30–60 minute pre-kickoff technical alignment followed by a 90-minute kickoff/requirements workshop.

Notes for handoff: include staging dataset access, a contact for their Security PO (Rajiv), and a SSO test account.

Thanks — I’ll be on standby to join the first call.

Best,
Priyom
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
Priyom Das | +1 (415) 555-0199
